Hi Irene,

Thanks for hosting the chat earlier. From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Park <dpark@finservco.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Apr 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for full penetration test report (confidential)

Hi Danielle — thanks for the note and the context.

Short answer: we are unable to share the raw, unredacted penetration test report (including PoC steps, exploit code, or detailed attack traces) outside of strict controlled procedures. That said, we want to be as helpful as possible to get you the evidence you need for your procurement review. Here are the options we can offer immediately:

1) Executive summary (attached): high-level findings, CVSS scores, scope, date, assessor, and remediation status. No PoC content is included.
2) Redacted findings package: we can provide the same report with sensitive PoC details removed and with risk indicators and remediation notes preserved.
3) On-screen controlled review: 60–90 minute session where a Redwood security engineer walks your security reviewers through the full report on a shared screen in a monitored Zoom session. No copies of the raw report can be downloaded or retained; attendees must sign our standard NDA/non-disclosure and complete identity verification.

Remediation snapshot (current):
- Critical: 2 items — both remediated on 2025-04-15 (patches deployed, verification completed).
- High: 1 item — mitigation in place, full fix scheduled for 2025-05-09. JIRA: SEC-2025-11.
- Medium: 4 items — in progress, ETA 2025-05-30. See remediation table attached.
- Low: backlog; scheduled Q3 maintenance windows.

Please let us know which option you prefer and the names/emails of the FinServCo reviewers for the on-screen session if you choose option 3. If you require a signed mutual NDA before the session, we can route through Legal.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood_pentest_execsummary_2025.pdf (application/pdf)]

If you have a redaction checklist or template, please attach so our security team can pre-approve.

Regards,

Team — copying legal because FinServCo wants PoC-level review in-session. A few legal/contractual notes before we schedule:

- We should limit the in-session audience to named reviewers and require an identity check at session start.
- Consider redacting IP addresses and any internal pathnames that reference customer data or internal logs — engineering, are there items that must remain redacted for third-party safety reasons?

Dev — can you prepare a short risk memo and a redaction checklist? Marcus — sales, please flag whether this impacts the procurement timeline or need for an exception.

Evelyn Hart
General Counsel

Quick tech notes for the redaction checklist and the session:
- Redact PoC exploit scripts, raw packet captures (PCAPs), and any ephemeral keys.
- Replace exact internal IP addresses with ranges (e.g., 10.x.x.x -> [redacted-internal-range]).
- Remove any customer-identifying log lines; keep anonymized examples that show reproducibility.
- For authenticate/authorization issues, we can show a sanitized step-by-step with screenshots and timestamps but no interactive PoC code.

Remediation status (links):
- SEC-2025-01 (Critical) — fixed 2025-04-15, verified by retest.
- SEC-2025-11 (High) — mitigation live; full fix ETA 2025-05-09.
- SEC-2025-21..24 (Medium) — in progress; owners assigned.

Irene — I can be on the call for the technical walkthrough. I'll attach draft redaction checklist.

Thanks,

Hi Danielle — thanks for confirming. Proposed next steps and logistics:

1) Legal attestation: Evelyn will send a one-page attendee attestation and no-recording agreement by EOD today. Please have each reviewer sign and return.
2) On-screen session: proposed windows next week (PST): Tue 2025-04-29 09:00–10:30, Wed 2025-04-30 09:00–10:30. Please confirm preferred slot and reviewer names/emails (max 3 attendees).
3) Prep materials: we will send the redacted findings package and the executive summary in advance (redactions per checklist). During the session, Dev will walk PoC steps on-screen with images and sanitized steps; no download allowed.
4) Evidence: we will show verification artifacts for remediated items (retest snapshots, JIRA numbers) and provide a remediation spreadsheet.

If FinServCo still requires the unredacted report for committee records, we can discuss an exception path but that will require a contracting amendment and on-site or strictly-provisioned SFTP access with additional contractual safeguards.

Please confirm the attendee list and preferred session time and we will route the attestation and calendar invite.

Best,
Irene
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
